plugins.name: pumpdata
plugins.description: pump.fun's whole on-chain history for coding agents: the pre-buy check (who launched a coin, its bundle and insiders, how launches like it went), a deployer's record, what any wallet did on pump.fun, base rates by market cap, and a time machine that replays a pick list against the chain with real fees and fills. Every pump.fun trade, ever. Read-only; free to start, no key.
